entries.description: The pipeline takes the AUM from an "AUM (Cr.)" column found on the header row or a label row above it, where the browser's parser found no AUM column or another one.
The pipeline attaches the market-cap shares of the header row to every scheme of the sheet (empty when the sheet has none); the browser's parser only to equity and hybrid sheets.
The pipeline rounds YTM, average maturity and modified duration to 4 places and drops the debt block when all three are empty.
A Direct issue's unnamed sheet (Sheet43, Others, Sheet 44 ...) takes the Regular sibling's category, else its sheet-mates' majority; also changes type.
A row with no AUM, inception date, market-cap share or fund word is marked as benchmark-like (bm).
